old:
You can start a document request before deciding on a Grade, but choose one Product Grade before submitting. You may request several document types for that Grade.

Evaluating more than one Grade? List the others in Additional Requirements for context. If you need different document types for each Grade, send a separate request for each one.
new:
Document requests are reviewed for a selected Grade. You may request several document types for that Grade.

If you are evaluating multiple Grades, provide the relevant context with your request or submit separate requests where different document sets are needed.

old: If you have identified a Grade, select it on the quotation form. Otherwise, choose “Not sure / Need help”. Add other candidates and any non-confidential requirements in Additional Requirements, then provide your application, quantity in metric tonnes and destination.
new: If you already have a Grade in mind, include it with your quotation request. If not, share your application, required quantity, destination and other relevant non-confidential requirements for review.
